title: Changelog
notes: Kept from day one on every project (Scout's own repo dogfoods it, D-002). PRD §6 lists this step as init+ongoing; the phase enum is single-valued, so phase=init carries the scaffolding and the ongoing maintenance is folded into the instruction text.
instruction: When a project begins, create CHANGELOG.md at the repo root. Then maintain it for the life of the project: whenever a meaningful, user-visible change lands, append a dated entry describing it in one or two plain-language lines — as part of landing the change itself, never batched for later. Keep the newest entries at the top.
